Domain Meaning: Strongest categorical predictor. Non-refundable deposits have extreme cancellation rate (99.4%) due to group block dumping.
Online TAs (36.7%) and Groups (61.1%) cancel far more frequently than Direct (15.3%) and Corporate (18.7%).
TA/TO distribution channels exhibit substantially higher cancellation proportion than Direct or Corporate channels.
City Hotel experiences significantly higher cancellation rate (41.7%) than Resort Hotel (27.8%).
Transient customers cancel substantially more often (40.7%) than Transient-Party (25.4%) or Group bookings.
Moderate-to-large effect size (d=0.634). Canceled bookings average 144.9 days in advance vs. 80.1 days for non-canceled.
Non-parametric confirmation: Median lead time for canceled bookings is 113 days vs. 45 days for completed stays (+151%).
Statistically significant due to large N, but practical effect size is negligible (d=0.099). Room rate is not a primary churn driver.
Median ADR for canceled bookings is only $3.60 higher ($96.30 vs. $92.70), confirming negligible practical divergence.
